A Portable Power Solution for Travelers and Gamers

Amazon has introduced a discount on the Daran 89.6Wh 100W Power Station, lowering its price to $49.99 through the use of a promotional coupon code. Measuring 6.5 inches by 3.3 inches by 4 inches and weighing approximately 2.5 pounds, the device bridges the gap between high-capacity power banks and traditional power stations by incorporating AC outlets alongside standard USB connections.

The hardware utilizes Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) battery cells rather than traditional NCM cells. LiFePO4 chemistry is widely recognized in the industry for offering a longer operational lifespan, slower calendar aging, and enhanced safety characteristics compared to older budget alternatives.

Specifications and Connectivity

With an 89.6Wh capacity—roughly equivalent to 28,000mAh at 3.2V—the power station complies with Transportation Security Administration (TSA) regulations, allowing it to be transported in carry-on luggage during commercial flights.

The unit features a total of seven charging ports to accommodate various electronic devices:

  • Two 120V AC outlets (100W maximum output)
  • Two USB-C ports (45W and 15W)
  • Two USB-A ports (18W and 15W)
  • One DC5521 port (60W)

The 100W capacity on the AC outlets is designed to support higher-draw mobile electronics, including laptops, tablets, and handheld gaming PCs, as well as legacy devices that rely on standard two-prong plugs instead of USB cables.

Practical Implications and Verification

For consumers evaluating this promotion, several factors remain confirmed while others require direct verification on the retail platform.

  • Confirmed: The promotional price of $49.99 requires applying the coupon code provided in the listing. Membership in Amazon Prime is not required to access this specific discount. The physical dimensions, weight, battery capacity, and port configurations are as stated by the retailer.
  • Unknown/Unconfirmed: The expiration date of the coupon code, total inventory levels, and the duration of the promotional pricing window are not specified in the source material.

Readers interested in verifying current availability, terms, or completing a purchase can review the active listing directly on the original [IGN Report](https://www.ign.com/articles/daran-lifepo4-power-station-deal-october-2026).
